claims.summary: For m disjoint Boolean blocks of size r, v=mr, their monomials z, affine binary tuple g=Az+b and h-row C, put P=product(1+(Cg)_u), k=rank(CA), s=(m-min(m,k+1))(r-1). Either Pg is identically zero, or every input-degree level of its joint multiplication image has dimension at least binomial(s,j). A consistent affine system Cg=0,g_i=1 has a solution of weight<=k+1; its feature pattern contains an s-dimensional Boolean subcube, and restriction is a strict filtered surjection. For r=Theta(log v), hr=o(v), K/v->kappa in (0,1/3), nonzero errors cannot satisfy the recorded harmonic binomial-cap test, even when existing codes make cumulative rank polynomially small. Weighted-free-cube realization is restricted to its coordinate multiplier domain and retains original replay.
claims.assessment: Working all-parameter subcube and graded-surjection proof, passed by the sole medium reviewer. The basis has not been extended to the full hard-quotient multiplier domain. Adaptive weights, nonconstant coefficient maps, overlapping features and other contraction criteria are not excluded. Known coded removal and a cheap positive weight repair remain valid.
claims.rationale: Tests the full nonlinear-prefix error kernel rather than only known affine annihilators and separates a sufficient harmonic profile from successful coded rank removal.
claims.next_action: Use a source-sensitive quantity that need not force harmonic degree levels; test the new basis-diversity criterion on actual mixed parents.

claims.summary: For a proper binary Boolean J_D, surviving degree-b weight w, U in V_K and fixed binary lifts f_l of a basis of [wU] of dimension H>0, consider a complete acyclic product-only ENS source at original ceiling B with b+K+B<=D. If R_a,l uniformly bounds the distinct nonzero input vectors of block a on Boolean support of w f_l, conditional on every earlier coherent row assignment, t_a independent active binary rows give expected stacked actual weighted error rank at most sum_l min(1,sum_a R_a,l*2^-t_a). If this is below H, one coherent constant assignment has a surviving common multiplier in U and excludes a degree-B PC refutation. Basis and weight precede row sampling; raw coefficient readers are excluded.
claims.assessment: Working conditional source criterion, same-medium-reviewer checked. It applies the earlier fiber-diversity conditional union bound to fixed basis supports and counts Boolean-zero columns with paid certificates; it does not substitute real point density for field rank or prove the diversity premise for arbitrary sources.
claims.rationale: Offers a basis-sensitive sufficient criterion without a harmonic level cap or a point-indicator basis. The remaining task is a useful actual-source diversity bound in the same weighted quotient.
claims.next_action: Test all allowable fixed low-degree bases against the independent outside-affine variation of actual affine-plus-product parents, retaining the known adaptive affine repair.
